name: Streamer Mode+
description: Blurs your DMs, servers, chat images and more while you stream, with hover to reveal. Turns on when you go live, with Discord's Streamer Mode, or by hotkey and /streamerplus.

notes: Says what it needs, which is nothing beyond what Discord already shows it, and Evi holds it to that.
Smoother channel switching: the page's styles are only touched when blurring actually changes.
